title: The Sealed Fork
summary: A festival-night delivery: an Authority tuning fork for the Bell Station.

stages.objective: Pick up tonight's delivery at the Post Office on Lantern Square.
stages.recap: Nessa said Postmistress Hale was looking for you. The Post Office is east of Wick Street, on Lantern Square.

stages.objective: Deliver the sealed fork to the Bell Station (north of Lantern Square).
stages.recap: Hale gave you a sealed Authority tuning fork for engineer Mira Fen at the Bell Station.

stages.objective: Join the Lanternwake crowd in Lantern Square for the toll.
stages.recap: Mira refused to install the fork — it was tuned wrong. Wren asked you to meet her at the Lantern Bridge after the toll.

stages.objective: Done.
stages.recap: The Lanternwake toll misfired.

title: What the Street Forgot
summary: After the misfired toll, everyone on Wick Street has forgotten Wren Vale. Rowan hasn't.

stages.objective: Find Wren at the Lantern Bridge on Wick Street.
stages.recap: The toll went wrong. Wren said she'd wait at the Lantern Bridge.

stages.objective: Find proof that Wren existed. (Check the Post Office, the bridge, and ask the children.)
stages.recap: Nobody on Wick Street remembers Wren — not even the neighbours who watched her grow up. You found her scarf. You need more proof.

stages.objective: Go home to Wick Street and think things through.
stages.recap: You have three pieces of proof: the scarf, the ledger page, and Pim's drawing. Wren existed.

stages.objective: Meet Mira at the Copper Kettle inn on Lantern Square.
stages.recap: Wardens tried to take the tuning fork. Garran Holt stepped in. Mira wants to talk at the Copper Kettle.

stages.objective: Enter the Station Undercroft through the canal hatch under the Lantern Bridge.
stages.recap: The night crew is trapped beneath the sealed station. Mira's key opens the canal maintenance hatch on the Wick Street dock.

stages.objective: Find the trapped night crew in the Undercroft.
stages.recap: Three engineers are missing below. The extraction logs may prove what happened to Wren.

stages.objective: Reach the bell core and stop the misfiring construct.
stages.recap: The survivors say a construct called the Clapper is still tolling in the bell core.

stages.objective: Escape Bellweather by barge.
stages.recap: You have Wren's countersigned log. The Authority will be looking for you.

title: The Lamplighter's Count
summary: Four festival lanterns went dark during the toll. Oswin can't remember which ones, only that the count is wrong.

stages.objective: Relight the dark lanterns with Lantern Oil (0/4 — two on Wick Street, two on Lantern Square).
stages.recap: Oswin gave you lantern oil. Dark lanterns are marked by cold, unlit glass.

stages.objective: Relight the dark lanterns (1/4).
stages.recap: One down.

stages.objective: Relight the dark lanterns (2/4).
stages.recap: Halfway.

stages.objective: Relight the dark lanterns (3/4).
stages.recap: One left.

stages.objective: Return to Oswin in Lantern Square.
stages.recap: All four lanterns burn again.

title: Ledger of Small Debts
summary: The stallkeeper Brisk and the cooper Dunmore each remember the other owing money. The toll took the truth.

stages.objective: Hear out Brisk (festival stall) and Dunmore (forge) in Lantern Square.
stages.recap: Two merchants are arguing over a debt neither clearly remembers.

stages.objective: Search the Wick Street dock crates for Dunmore's lost receipt box.
stages.recap: Dunmore kept receipts in a crate he sent to the dock before the festival.

stages.objective: Decide what to do with the receipt.
stages.recap: The receipt proves Dunmore owes Brisk 300 crowns — but Dunmore's workshop is struggling.

stages.objective: Done.

outcomes.truth: You showed Brisk the receipt. The debt was paid, stiffly. Brisk trusts records now; Dunmore is cool toward you.
outcomes.mercy: You proposed they split the loss and burned the receipt. Neither is fully satisfied, but they're speaking again.

title: Mira: The Weight of Blueprints
summary: Mira designed the resonators that make extraction possible. Stage 1 of her personal story.

stages.objective: Talk with Mira on the inn balcony before entering the Undercroft.
stages.recap: Mira seemed to want to say something at the Copper Kettle.

stages.objective: Stage 1 complete. Her story continues in Chapter Two (not yet built).
stages.recap: Mira admitted she drew the resonator plans. She wants to fix what she built.

title: Garran: The Order He Refused
summary: Why was Garran stripped of his badge? Stage 1 of his personal story.

stages.objective: Ask Garran about his old badge at the Copper Kettle bar.
stages.recap: Garran keeps touching the place his badge used to be.

stages.objective: Stage 1 complete. His story continues in Chapter Three (not yet built).
stages.recap: Garran refused an order at Glass Orchard. He won't say yet what it was.

title: No One Left Below
summary: Tamsin believes a third night-crew member, the porter Joss, is still somewhere in the cistern.

stages.objective: Find Joss somewhere in the flooded cistern.
stages.recap: Joss went to check the east sluice and never came back.

stages.objective: Bring Joss back to Tamsin's cache.
stages.recap: You found Joss hiding behind the old sluice gate.

stages.objective: Done.

title: The Rainward Line
summary: The barge delivers you to Rainward Junction. The coast — and the Salt Archive — are down the line, but the freight is stalled at Millbrook Cutting, and the junction is full of people who no longer know where they came from.

stages.objective: Look around Rainward Junction. Find somewhere to lie low.
stages.recap: You arrived by barge. Wanted posters with your face are on the platform.

stages.objective: Hear the displaced families' accounts of what happened at Millbrook (0/3).
stages.recap: The camp by the platform is Millbrook's whole population. Their accounts don't agree.

stages.objective: Hear the displaced families' accounts (1/3).
stages.recap: One account heard.

stages.objective: Hear the displaced families' accounts (2/3).
stages.recap: Two accounts heard.

stages.objective: Walk the line east to the stalled freight and get it moving.
stages.recap: Three accounts that can't all be true. The answer is at Millbrook, past the stalled freight.

stages.objective: Clear the stalled freight car by car.
stages.recap: Something is living in the freight cars.

stages.objective: Reach Millbrook Cutting and deal with the signal post blocking the line.
stages.recap: The freight's crew say the signal post at the cutting has gone wrong — it attacks anything on the line.

stages.objective: Find stationmaster Odile Brack at Millbrook Halt.
stages.recap: The line is clear. Millbrook Halt is just past the cutting.

stages.objective: Decide what to do with the station logs.
stages.recap: Odile kept two sets of logs. The real ones show years of hidden over-quota tolls.

stages.objective: Board the freight toward Glass Orchard.
stages.recap: The freight is ready.

title: Nessa: The Captain's Ledger
summary: Nessa owes Captain Ferro more than money. Stage 1 of her personal story.

stages.objective: Find Nessa on the barge dock at Rainward Junction.
stages.recap: Nessa went quiet when Captain Ferro's barge docked.

stages.objective: Stage 1 complete. Her story continues in a later chapter (not yet built).
stages.recap: Ferro wants Nessa to carry a parcel for 'friends in the Authority'. She hasn't said yes. She hasn't said no.

title: Sera: Acceptable Losses
summary: Sera keeps a list of names the Authority's ledgers call 'acceptable losses'. Stage 1 of her personal story.

stages.objective: Talk with Sera at Millbrook Halt.
stages.recap: Sera has been writing in a small book by lamplight.

stages.objective: Stage 1 complete. Her story continues in a later chapter (not yet built).
stages.recap: Sera's list has four hundred names. She says one of them used to be hers.

title: Names on the Doors
summary: Millbrook's people pinned notes on their doors so they'd remember who lives where. The rain washed the ink.

stages.objective: Check the three washed-out door notes in Millbrook (0/3).
stages.recap: Maud asked you to read what's left of the notes.

stages.objective: Check the door notes (1/3).
Check the door notes (2/3).
Report to Maud.
stages.recap: You read all three notes.

stages.objective: Done.

title: Rain Rations
summary: The camp's food crate is short. The Authority depot next door has plenty — under seal.

stages.objective: Talk to the depot clerk about the sealed crates.
stages.recap: The camp is short of food.

stages.objective: Decide: buy food for the camp (300 crowns) or break the depot seal.
stages.recap: The clerk can't open the seal without orders.

stages.objective: Done.

outcomes.paid: You paid for the food. The clerk quietly added extra. The camp eats.
outcomes.seal: You broke the seal at night. The camp eats — and wardens on the Line now look harder at couriers.
